**Finding submitted: deviation.**

- **What's there:** Article XV gives only Effective-Date representations from Array (corporate authority, no conflicting IP grants, no litigation, patent ownership/validity, regulatory and anti-bribery compliance). Section 15.4 disclaims all other express and implied warranties, though it properly carves out warranties "expressly set forth in this Agreement."
- **What's missing:** No warranty that the Materials (Drug Substance / Drug Product) Array supplies under Article IX conform to specifications or were manufactured under GMP, and no remedy (replacement, repair or refund). Article IX defers specifications and "customary terms" to supply agreements yet to be negotiated (¶¶ p0501, p0510), so Ono has no conformance protection under this Agreement — below even the playbook fallback.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 9.7 warranting conformity to specifications/certificate of analysis and GMP through shelf life, plus a professional-and-workmanlike performance warranty, with replacement or refund at Ono's election including shipping/destruction costs. Fallback offered in the comment: a shorter warranty window tied to shelf life to match Array's upstream subcontractor terms.
